comment: The far ground's painted detail (assets/shaders/terrain_core/far_detail.hlsli): past `start_m` from the eye, fully on by `full_m`, the ground gets what its mesh and its 4 m textures can no longer show - gullies cut down the slopes and ridges worn light (`erosion`), bedding bands in the steep rock (`strata`), the ground's hollows dark and its crests pale from the clipmap's own curvature (`cavity`), a coarse mottle (`mottle`), grass that reads as a sward at a grazing look (`sward`), and forest as a canopy of crowns painted on the ground (`canopy`) wherever the tree layers named under `canopy_layers` grow - by the same biome rules, cluster noise and seed as foliage.json, so the painted forest is where the trees are and carries on past their 3.5 km range. Each canopy layer: [r, g, b] - the mean colour of its trees' textures. Nothing here has to agree from frame to frame or with the geometry: it is paint. 0 switches a part off.
